_comment: v0.1 SCORE §6.1 config. Handmade stepwise wealth tests must pass before any 500-rep paper-scale run. This file does not start Monte Carlo. SCORE+ without assume_cpqd is N/A / INVALID_PROTOCOL.

source.paper: SCORE: A Unified Framework for Overshoot Refund in Online FDR Control (Kuang, Gang, Xia)

cpqd_justification: Section 6.1 is independent e-values; SCORE+ thresholds are monotone in the rejection history (Appendix A sufficient condition).
power_definition: AP(t) = expected fraction of non-nulls arrived by t that are rejected; power ratio vs family baseline (e-LORD or e-SAFFRON), pointwise in t.
score_plus_update: alpha_t = omega_t * (R_{t-1} v 1) * W_t, W_t = alpha - sum_{j<t} (alpha_j - O_j)_+ / (R_{t-1} v 1)
